description: Which chain each chain source must describe, and which existing Undrly instrument each issuer address list is about (docs/v1.5-solana.md). No address or mint is stated here: those come only from the issuer's own published list, stored raw first. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

chains.name: Solana
chains.authority: The cluster's own getGenesisHash (Solana docs: https://solana.com/docs/references/clusters, https://solana.com/docs/rpc/http/getgenesishash); CAIP-2 Solana profile: the genesis hash truncated to 32 characters (https://github.com/ChainAgnostic/namespaces/blob/main/solana/caip2.md). A response for any other cluster is rejected.

issuers.authority: Circle issues USDC; its developer documentation lists the USDC contract address on every supported mainnet. Only the `## Mainnet` table is read.
